name: Pinterest
one_liner: Pinterest API v5 provides REST endpoints for managing pins, boards, catalogs, ads, and analytics, accessed via OAuth 2.0.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant with refresh tokens.
access_notes: Trial access allows full API usage with daily limits; upgrade to Standard for higher limits.

extras.rate_limits: Trial access: 1000 requests per day for all API requests; Standard access: 100 requests per second per user per app.

evidence.snippet: Build a working authentication flow based on OAuth 2
Application requests are reviewed each business day.

- Product limited tokens: Once your app is approved for Trial access you can generate a token to test the API without setting up the Oauth flow.Test tokens expire after 24 hours and allow you to explore certain endpoints faster.
* The [pinterest/api-description](https://github.com/pinterest/api-description) repo on GitHub contains [OpenAPI](https://www.openapis.org/) descriptions for Pinterest's REST API.
